grok_code_fast_1/001: The strategy for this policy is a minimax-based approach with a depth-limited search (depth 3 for reasonableness within the 1-second time limit). The policy selects the move that maximizes the expected evaluation under minimax, ensuring mandatory captures. If multiple moves tie, it selects the first one for simplicity. This balances depth with heuristics to avoid illegal moves and outperform random or shallow policies in the arena.
